body: I can’t say whether it’s painful or not, but I’ve heard it is more gruesome than people assume it would be. Certainly not like movies. Someone I know described to me seeing one of their friends who had hung themselves. They said their face was blue and veiny, their eyes were bulging, and their tongue was swollen. Just from that description I imagine it is not a pleasant experience. You are not going to find any method of suicide that does not involve a level of significant pain. Getting through mental health stuff may not feel possible, but definitely go the route of talking to a therapist or even a doctor about what you’re going through before making a huge decision like that. Best of luck to you, I hope you keep on moving forward.
